newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower in thin trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended lower on Monday after the key Nikkei index battled fiercely to avoid sinking past the 20,000 level on pressure from the Dow, brokers said.
They said trade was thin and centred around speculative, incentive-backed shares.
The 225-issue benchmark Nikkei lost 59.79 points or 0.30 percent to close at 21,107.11. Its September futures shed 20 points to settle at 20,150.
"The Nikkei average was in a tug-of-war state for most of the day near the 20,000 level," said Harushige Kobayashi, deputy general manager at Yamaichi Securities.
